entries.title: Numbers 13:1
segments: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 13:2
segments: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.

entries.title: Numbers 13:3
segments: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 13:4
segments: And these were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

entries.title: Numbers 13:5
segments: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

entries.title: Numbers 13:6
segments: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.title: Numbers 13:7
segments: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

entries.title: Numbers 13:8
segments: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

entries.title: Numbers 13:9
segments: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

entries.title: Numbers 13:10
segments: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:11
segments: Of the tribe of Joseph, [namely], of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:12
segments: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

entries.title: Numbers 13:13
segments: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

entries.title: Numbers 13:14
segments: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:15
segments: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:16
segments: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

entries.title: Numbers 13:17
segments: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way by the South, and go up into the hill-country:

entries.title: Numbers 13:18
segments: and see the land, what it is; and the people that dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

entries.title: Numbers 13:19
segments: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

entries.title: Numbers 13:20
segments: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

entries.title: Numbers 13:21
segments: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

entries.title: Numbers 13:22
segments: And they went up by the South, and came unto Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

entries.title: Numbers 13:23
segments: And they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it upon a staff between two; [they brought] also of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

entries.title: Numbers 13:24
segments: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

entries.title: Numbers 13:25
segments: And they returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

entries.title: Numbers 13:26
segments: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

entries.title: Numbers 13:27
segments: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us; and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

entries.title: Numbers 13:28
segments: Howbeit the people that dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, [and] very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

entries.title: Numbers 13:29
segments: Amalek dwelleth in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill-country; and the Canaanite dwelleth by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.

entries.title: Numbers 13:30
segments: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

entries.title: Numbers 13:31
segments: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

entries.title: Numbers 13:32
segments: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of great stature.

entries.title: Numbers 13:33
segments: And there we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
